evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server binding logic and authentication handling in src/httpserver.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a local credential leak where bitcoind could start on IPv6 while an untrusted local process occupies the default IPv4 RPC port, causing bitcoin-cli to send the authentication cookie to the foreign process in plaintext. As verified by reviewers, leaving this unresolved allows local credential capture and unauthorized RPC execution.
